thread:
Ivy: heads-up - a couple models in the intake queue have subtle tokenizer normalizer mismatches. Eval inputs tokenize to different token counts between our tokenizer lib and the model's provided tokenizer binary. symptoms: early truncation in reranker jobs.

Marco: sounds like a normalization config difference (NFKC vs NFC) or a hidden pre-tokenizer step. can we detect this deterministically in intake?

Eve: propose a quick "norm-diff" probe: sample 100 evals, run both tokenizer implementations (registry-proc and model-provided if available), count normalization diffs and token-count deltas. if diffs > 2% -> WARN; >8% -> FAIL.

Ivy: keep it low-latency. run async worker and block synchronously max 2.5s for a result. default to WARN if timed out.

ingest-bot: enqueued 3032101111 | norm-diff-probe(samples=100) on worker-4 :gear:

Marco: also record a tokenizer_normalizer_fingerprint = sha256(normalizer_config + normalizer_version) and persist to model metadata. that helps correlate regressions later.

Eve: add metadata keys: tokenizer_normalizer, normalizer_version, normalizer_fingerprint. UI should surface the one-line probe summary on model page.

Ivy: routing rules: PASS -> fastpath, WARN -> fastpath + schedule deepbench async, FAIL -> block and create deepbench ticket attaching probe output. We need to be conservative with FAIL thresholds until we gather telemetry.

Marco: edgecases: some models intentionally preprocess text (custom whitespace handling). add model_metadata.declared_preprocessor to skip or apply alternate thresholds.

Eve: telemetry dims: norm_probe.latency_ms, norm_probe.diff_rate, norm_probe.result. will chart per-model-family.

Ivy: owners: Eve implements probe + tests, Marco adds fingerprint and registry fields, I'll update intake router for routing + UI hook. Add small local CLI for dev dbg.

Eve: will PR tests for unicode edgecases and a byte-level bypass.

Ivy: thanks all. tagging @Eve for follow-up. :thumbsup:
